versions.changelog: Force Polymarket/Kalshi queries to route to liberfi-predict, not liberfi-token/market/portfolio.

Make CLI install instructions explicit and unambiguous; tell agents the npm package is @liberfi.io/cli, fall back to --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ on mirror lag, and never report 'package not found'.

Liberfi-portfolio 1.0.0

- Initial release providing wallet portfolio analysis on supported blockchains.
- View token holdings with current values, check transaction activity/history, and track PnL statistics over customizable time windows.
- Query total wallet net worth and generate consolidated portfolio reports.
- Supports both public wallet queries (chain and address required) and authenticated “me” queries for the user’s LiberFi TEE wallet (no address needed).
- Clear command routing and triggers; includes comprehensive usage guidance, CRITICAL instructions, and authentication flows.
